headline: Spending $425,000 on a Bennington Triangle park, plus tabled items on opioid funds, grants, and a housing incentive plan.
summary: The main new item is a $425,000 grant from EOEEA for building a park at the Bennington Triangle site. Older items that were tabled include a $400,000 transfer for the Prospering Lawrence Grant and an update on opioid settlement funds.
items: Authorize spending of $425,000 grant from EOEEA for park construction at Bennington Triangle site; approve resolution (Susan Fink)
Request investigation of unclaimed properties listed as City of Lawrence on MissingMoney.com (tabled from May 5, 2026)
Accept donation of 15 passenger vans from Merrimack Valley Transit Authority (tabled from April 21, 2026)
Review Lawrence Redevelopment Authority's financials (tabled from April 1, 2025)
Opioid settlement funds update on Modelo Application Development (tabled from February 4, 2025)
Transfer $400,000 from ARPA/Free Cash to small businesses through Prospering Lawrence Grant (tabled from December 3, 2024)

Resolution amending and rescinding reimbursement requirement for Creating a Thriving Lawrence Grant awardees; $150K to Greater Lawrence Family Health Center and $100K to Lawrence General Hospital (tabled from May 7, 2024)
Amend City's Housing Development Incentive Plan by changing the Tax Increment Exemption percentage (tabled from February 6, 2024)
location: City Council Chambers, 200 Common Street, Lawrence, MA
